body: character reference sheet T-POSE, arms outstretched horizontally like an airplane / scarecrow -- a chibi voxel-block toy figure of an engineer with BOTH ARMS RAISED STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height (NOT down at the hips, elbows fully straight, each arm forming a straight horizontal line from the shoulder, a large visible gap between each arm and the torso), both blocky hands open with fingers spread, nothing held. Big oversized blocky head (same chibi head-to-body ratio as a toy figure, NOT a realistic human proportion) and a broad stocky short blocky body, wider-shouldered than the others but same tiny voxel-block toy scale, made of assembled rectangular blocks, every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, NO smooth curves, NO soft gradient shading -- each block face a single FLAT solid color with a bold thick black outline stroke around every edge like a toy render. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart, nothing overlapping the torso or legs. Matte dark navy-charcoal blocky mech-plate armor with thick gold trim blocks, a blocky hardhat helmet block with a flat glowing CYAN-TEAL rectangle for eyes (not red, not orange), a wrench block holstered flat on the belt, blocky boots. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, full body visible head to feet, no text, no logos, no watermark, no signature
